page_title: BAR 2-0 RMA | Barcelona v Real Madrid 10/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
88' Today's match ends for Fermín who will be replaced by Alejandro Balde (Barcelona).

86' Cesar Palacios (Real Madrid) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He creates some space for the shot, but blazes it high over the crossbar. Very bad attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
85' None of the Barcelona players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.

84' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Thibaut Courtois makes a great save. Barcelona will take a corner kick.
83' Raphinha (Barcelona) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.
81' The referee is firm and issues Raphinha (Barcelona) a deserved yellow card.
81' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
81' Fermín (Barcelona) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Cesar Palacios (Real Madrid) for Gonzalo Garcia.
79' Substitution. Brahim Diaz walks off the pitch and Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
77' Real Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Gavi and he is replaced by Marc Bernal (Barcelona).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) will replace Ferran Torres.
75' The corner is swung in but Real Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

74' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) plants a good close-range header towards goal from the corner kick, but it comes to nothing as a defender comfortably blocks the effort. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Real Madrid get a corner.
72' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
70' Substitution. Thiago Pitarch (Real Madrid) on for Eduardo Camavinga.
68' Wow, what an escape. Fermín (Barcelona) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
66' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
65' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) dribbles into the box, but Joan Garcia is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
64' Hansi Flick decides to make a substitution. Dani Olmo will be replaced by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marcus Rashford leaves the pitch and Raphinha (Barcelona) comes on.
63' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) has a goal ruled out for offside!
63' The resulting set piece from Real Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' It seemed like Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
60' The referee blows his whistle as Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Real Madrid in a dangerous position.
59' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) tackles a bit over-zealously and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
57' Barcelona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

56' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Thibaut Courtois, who tips the ball around the post. Barcelona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
55' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
55' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
53' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
52' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
52' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
49' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
48' Fermín (Barcelona) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Barcelona.
48' A pass from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is intercepted by Thibaut Courtois and the move breaks down.
47' The attendance is 62213.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
42' Barcelona couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Thibaut Courtois (Real Madrid) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
41' Looks like Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
40' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) for his blatant foul.

39' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) looks furious with himself after spurning a great chance. He pounces on the rebound around the penalty spot and drags a shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
39' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

38' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) gets inside the box and tries to beat Thibaut Courtois with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. Good work from Barcelona as they win a corner.
36' Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) is penalised for a foul. Alejandro Hernandez had a clear view and blows his whistle.
35' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.

33' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
31' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) attempts to release Marcus Rashford with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
30' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
28' The Barcelona players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
26' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
24' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Madrid comes to nothing.

24' This should have been a goal! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) sends a killer pass into the box, but Vinicius Junior can't trick the opposition's defence and loses possession. The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Madrid are going to take it.
22' Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
21' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
18' 2 - 0 Goal! Dani Olmo displays great vision and sends a pass to Ferran Torres (Barcelona), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the right post. The score is 2:0.
17' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle and it's Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
15' Neat passing move from Barcelona in order to create new attacking opportunities.

13' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but he sent it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
13' The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Madrid. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.

12' Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) gets to the ball swung in from the corner and plants a close-range header low towards goal, but it's blocked then cleared away. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
11' Real Madrid earn a corner.
9' 1 - 0 Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight into the top left corner. A technically perfect strike!
9' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position, just outside the box.
8' Referee Alejandro Hernandez sees the trip by Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Barcelona have a free kick from a promising distance.
7' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Good defending. Fermín (Barcelona) tries to find Marcus Rashford inside the box, but the pass is cut out. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will take a throw-in.

3' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.

2' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Joan Garcia makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
